name: credit contested during the work
what_it_changes: Within F17, members dispute and correct who made the work while it is still being placed: accusations, denials, competing labour claims and corrected omissions.
why: Cut rule R3: a level-3 child of F17's key, held by 5 or more of its members, whose lines (read in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P11_T4-026.txt) state a narrower change than F17's. 'Credit is actively checked and corrected during ongoing work rather than appearing only at the close' (anime); 'Attribution includes disputes about authentic makers, first arrival and proof during ongoing work' (Okami). These are the labelers' how sentences.
